title: A Summer for the Harbor
author: Marguerite Ashgrove
blurb: Lior Montrose, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
